title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: The manifest badge called VIBRATE unused, greyed the line and offered to remove it. A notification channel that asks for vibration needs that permission, and it never mentions the vibrator.

highlights.title: Channels ask for it too
highlights.description: The table knew only the direct vibrator API. It now counts enableVibration, setVibrate, DEFAULT_VIBRATE and vibrationPattern.

highlights.title: The only wrong badge, gone
highlights.description: Of 56 permissions across 51 manifests on the project measured, VIBRATE was the only one marked unused. Nothing is greyed any more.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The project calls enableVibration(true) on its notification channels in five places; removing the permission would silence them.
A second test pins the other direction: a project that never asks for vibration still gets the finding.
